aboutPage.label: About
aboutPage.title: Photographer & filmmaker — studio roots in India, creating in Germany.
aboutPage.intro: I run a photo and video studio in India, delivering cinematic photography, films, and edits for weddings, pre-weddings, products, and brands—from first idea through post-production. After years of work across Rajasthan, Delhi, and beyond, I am now based in Germany and collaborate with couples, companies, and agencies here, as well as on projects between Europe and India.
